ACT No. XXII of

(For
Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1965, Ext., p. 1390.)
[6th December,
1965]
An Act to give
effect to the supplementary financial proposals of the Central Government for
the year ending on the thirtieth day of June, 1966
1. Short title extent and
commencement---------(1) This Act may be called the Finance (Supplementary)
Act, 1965.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Defence Surcharge on customs duty

THE FINANCE (SUPPLEMENTARY) ACT, 1965
THE FINANCE
(SUPPLEMENTARY) ACT, 1965
ACT No. XXII of
1965
(For
Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1965, Ext., p. 1390.)
[6th December,
1965]
An Act to give
effect to the supplementary financial proposals of the Central Government for
the year ending on the thirtieth day of June, 1966
2. Defence Surcharge on
customs duty------There shall be levied and collected an additional
customs-duty as defence surcharge on the goods specified in the Schedule to
this Act at the rate of twenty-five per cent of the customs-duty payable
thereon.

Defence surcharge on the duty of excise

An Act to give

3. Defence surcharge on the
duty of excise------There shall be levied and collected an additional duty
of excise as defence surcharge on the goods falling under items 1, 4, 19A, 19B,
19C, 20 and 31 of the First Schedule to the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944,
at the rate of twenty-five per cent of the excise duty payable thereon. I of
1944.

4. Defence surcharge on sales
tax-----There shall be levied and collected an additional tax as defence
surcharge on the goods liable to the payment of tax under the Sales Tax Act,
1951, at the rate of twenty-five per cent of such tax payable thereon. III of
1951

Procedure for collection of defence surcharge

THE FINANCE (SUPPLEMENTARY) ACT, 1965
THE FINANCE
(SUPPLEMENTARY) ACT, 1965
ACT No. XXII of
1965
(For
Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1965, Ext., p. 1390.)
[6th December,
1965]
An Act to give
effect to the supplementary financial proposals of the Central Government for

5. Procedure for collection of
defence surcharge-----The additional duty or tax leviable as defence
surcharge under section 2, section 3 or section 4 shall be recovered at the
same time and in the same manner as the duty or tax in addition to which it is
to be levied and collected and all the provisions of the Sea Customs Act, 1878,
the Land Customs Act, 1924, the Tariff Act, 1934, the Central Excises and Salt
Act, 1944, or the Sales Tax Act, 1951, as the case may be, shall apply to such
levy and collection. VIII of 1878 XIX of 1924 XXXII of 1934 I of 1944 III of
1951.
